sanity_expectations: I(w) is finite, real, and strictly positive over the sampled range
single peak between ~9e4 and ~1.1e5 rad/s (slightly above the bare-LC resonance 1/sqrt(LC)=1e5 due to the added -1/(C_stray*w) branch)
peak amplitude ~0.05-0.06 A (limited primarily by R+R_s and the dielectric-loss term)
monotonic decay of I on both sides of the peak toward the sampled boundaries
I decreases when C_stray is decreased holding all else fixed (larger stray-C reactance detunes and lowers peak)
excitation_report: Single additive term in explicit form; total RMS = 11.6*sigma across the log-sweep. New term -1/(C_stray*w) reaches max_effect 0.045 (~90*sigma), strongest at w≈97,676 rad/s — well inside the sampled window. The stray capacitance branch shifts the reactive-zero from the bare LC point (~100 krad/s) and modifies the peak height/shape distinctly from the parent equation, so the term is clearly visible above noise.
role_corrections: I: O->O (confirmed: solved LHS in explicit form)
w: V->V (confirmed: only sweep axis; sole free non-parameter symbol on RHS)
R: V->P (overridden: fixed component value in the phenomenon, not swept)
V: V->P (overridden: fixed drive amplitude in the phenomenon, not swept)
R_L: P->P (confirmed: parallel core-loss resistance held large so peak isn't overwhelmed)
C_stray: P->P (confirmed: value chosen ~10x C so the new branch is a distinct but non-destructive perturbation)
rationale: Static explicit relation I = V/|Z(w)| for a driven series RLC with parasitics. Only w is a sweep axis; everything else is a fixed component or drive property. Chose L=10 mH, C=10 nF (bare resonance ~1e5 rad/s ≈ 15.9 kHz), R_L=1 MΩ so core-loss doesn't crush the peak, D_f=0.01, small alpha_L and R_skin so those terms perturb (not dominate) reactance and resistance respectively, and C_stray=100 nF (upper end of the suggested 1e-12–1e-8 hint has C_stray << C which would destroy the resonance; here C_stray is 10x C so the -1/(C_stray*w) branch is a clean ~10% perturbation of the reactive sum). Log-scaled w sweep from 3e4 to 3e5 rad/s brackets the peak with generous decades. sigma=5e-4 is ~1% of peak; excitation_check confirms total RMS 11.6*sigma and new-term 90*sigma."
